f75c84e0-aaf1-4262-9d61-ca4b6f1e672a@nin.why: San Francisco enters 2-0 and alone atop the NFC West, while Arizona is rebuilding under new coach Mike LaFleur after Kyler Murray is gone, Jacoby Brissett is the starting quarterback. A win keeps the 49ers unbeaten and moving toward a 3-0 start for the fourth time in Kyle Shanahan's reign; a loss would be a rare stumble but changes little this early. Nobody clinches a playoff spot or gets eliminated at Week 3.
f75c84e0-aaf1-4262-9d61-ca4b6f1e672a@nin.know: A "division game" counts extra because the division winner is guaranteed a playoff spot, so these matchups shape tiebreakers all year. Watch QB Brock Purdy, who has led San Francisco with a near-perfect two weeks, becoming the fifth QB in NFL history to post multiple 90% completion games. Also watch Cardinals TE Trey McBride, coming off a 1,000-yard campaign as Arizona's top target.

75b7b5e8-6b02-4eee-a2ca-0ce91d9bc037@ufc.why: Ranked No. 12 and No. 13, Raul Rosas Jr. and Raoni Barcelos enter this pivotal matchup riding five-fight winning streaks, with a potential Top-10 position at stake. In the co-main, both Norma Dumont and Ailin Perez know that victory is essential if they want to force their way into championship contention by the end of 2026. The rivalry between the two women's bantamweight contenders has organically developed after years of back-and-forth online.
75b7b5e8-6b02-4eee-a2ca-0ce91d9bc037@ufc.know: At just 21, Rosas Jr. is one of the most dangerous grapplers in the division, built around wrestling pressure and scrambling. Barcelos, 39, is a technically complete veteran who may be the most experienced opponent of Rosas' career. This is also the first scheduled five-round bout for both fighters, a longer format normally reserved for the most important fights on a card.

1d50a2bd-0890-4b61-9474-b92435185adb@ufc.why: The vacant women's flyweight title headlines, after champion Valentina Shevchenko was sidelined roughly a year by injury. Top contender Natalia Silva, an 8-0 UFC striker, faces surging striker Wang Cong, who owns a kickboxing win over Shevchenko and could set up a rematch if she wins. Either winner earns her first UFC title.
1d50a2bd-0890-4b61-9474-b92435185adb@ufc.know: A number like "UFC 332" marks a flagship pay-per-view style card, reserved for title fights and top names, unlike smaller weekly "Fight Night" events. In the co-main, former two-time flyweight champion Deiveson Figueiredo tests rising unbeaten prospect Payton Talbott at bantamweight, a classic veteran-versus-prospect gatekeeper matchup that can launch a newcomer into title contention.
